data.raw_text:
"Secretary Aguda is out here sleep-talking again 😴💤: 'PH is perfectly located for data centers — we're the new Hormuz Strait for data!' 

Bro, while you're romanticizing geography, the **Middle East war** just spiked global oil prices, forcing Marcos to declare a **national energy emergency** ⚠️. Philippines imports most of its fuel from there — oil, gas, and LNG prices are surging, with electricity rates projected to jump **P2–P4/kWh** (or more) this April-May 😱 on top of our already **highest-in-ASEAN power costs** (Meralco at ₱13+ and climbing). 

Data centers devour **hundreds of MW** nonstop for servers and cooling. How do you keep 99.999% uptime when our grid has thin reserves, plants trip during summer demand 🌡️, and typhoon season + flooding knocks out transmission lines yearly? 🌪️ Servers don't swim, and blackouts aren't an option. 

Oh right — the same archipelago battered by super typhoons, earthquakes on the Ring of Fire, and chronic flooding. This isn't 'next oil' — it's next-level delusion while Filipinos pay premium for flickering lights and businesses get crushed by sky-high rates. 💸⚡

Fix the basics first: cheap & reliable power, disaster-proof infrastructure, and cut the red tape/corruption scaring real investors. Wake up, sir. 🌪️⚡💸 #DataCenterReality"
